init_hook: qed() { if [ -x .lake/build/bin/qed ]; then .lake/build/bin/qed "$@"; else echo 'qed not built. Run: devbox run build' >&2; return 1; fi; }

scripts.check: lake build && lake test && .lake/build/bin/docgen schema | diff docs/spec.schema.json - && .lake/build/bin/docgen markdown | diff docs/spec-format.md -
